Hi Carmen — thanks for the clarity. Attached is a first-pass MAP (Greenfield_MAP-v1.xlsx) and an embedded summary below. High level:

Milestones (owner) and target dates:
- Kickoff & infra checklist (Greenfield IT + Redwood eng) — 2026-06-21
- Smoke test run (joint, Redwood provides scripts) — 2026-06-25
- 2-week pilot evaluation (functional + performance) — 2026-06-26 to 2026-07-09
- Decision & contract close — target 2026-07-12

Exit gates (pass):
- Functional: >= 95% intent classification F1 on our sample test set
- Performance: p95 latency <= 450ms at sampled production load (burst to 50 RPS)
- Cost: average token cost estimate within 20% of the proposal
- Security: SSO + KMS integration validated in staging

If any of the pass gates fail we propose a single remediation sprint (2 business days) and then a re-run; failures after remediation will be considered a go/no-go. See attached sheet for owner-by-owner checklist.

Next step: Ben, can you add the smoke-test checklist items and confirm which tests Redwood will run vs Greenfield?

Attached: greenfield-smoke-tests.md and pricing-term-sheet.pdf. Draft of acceptance tests (extracted for the MAP):

Acceptance tests (who/runs/threshold):
- Functional smoke (Greenfield run, 50 sample queries): pass if no severe regressions and overall F1 >= 0.95.
- Integration test (Redwood run): SSO + KMS flow completes end-to-end in <= 2 attempts.
- Performance sweep (Redwood run): p50/p95/p99 latency measurements at 1x and 3x expected load; p95 <= 450ms, p99 <= 900ms.
- Token-cost estimate (Redwood run): simulated tokens on a 10k sample, cost projection within budget variance (<=20%).
- Stability (Redwood run): 48-hour soak with synthetic traffic at 1x expected load, error rate <= 0.1%.

I've added test names and scripts to greenfield-smoke-tests.md. For the remediation flow: if any test fails, we will log an owner and proposed fix window (48 hours). Major failures (security, PII leakage) are immediate stop conditions and require leadership review.

Suggested timeline (to fit Carmen's decision date):
- 6/21: Kickoff + infra access granted
- 6/25: Redwood runs perf & cost simulations; Greenfield runs basic functional smoke
- 6/28: Joint evaluation readout
- 7/08: Final go/no-go decision window (adds time for procurement);

Open: Carmen, are you ok with the 48-hour remediation window and the 48-hour soak test requirement?

Thanks,
